Alex — great, that helps. Quick, transparent math and recommendations below. I kept the numbers conservative — we can tighten for an SOW.

Unit economics (hosted API, per 1M tokens):
- US region (hosted): baseline example: $1,700 / 1M tokens (includes model costs, serving, caching benefits).
- EU region (hosted, EU-resident infra): baseline example: $1,980 / 1M tokens (~16% uplift vs US).

Why the EU uplift (~12–18% typical):
- Additional regional infra and smaller regional pools increase per-token GPU amortization.
- Data residency control plane and audit logging retention add marginal infra + ops costs.
- Cross-region egress and redundancy for failover increase expected costs.

Options for your volumes (300M -> 1B tokens/month):
1) Hosted API (EU residency): fastest onboarding, EU-hosted endpoints only for EU traffic. Per-token cost above; good for pilot and when you want minimal ops.
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity): if you commit to monthly capacity (e.g., 500M+ tokens equivalent throughput), we can offer reserved pricing — typical additional discount ranges 20–35% off hosted list depending on term and utilization. For example, a committed Dedicated price might land you at ~$1,360 / 1M tokens effective in US, and ~$1,600 / 1M in EU after residency premium.

Other levers to reduce effective cost:
- Batching and prefix/KV caching for repeat prompts can reduce billable tokens by ~10–25% depending on workload.
- Model selection / quantization: if you can accept a quantized variant for certain routes, that reduces per-token compute.
- Commitment tiers and auto-scaling windows: bursts covered by overage rates vs larger reserved buffers.

Recommended next steps:
- If your procurement target is <= $2k / 1M hosted, start with Hosted EU residency for EU traffic and Hosted US for US traffic; we can pilot on those numbers and measure effective token usage with caching.
- Parallel: we can model Dedicated committed pricing for a 12-month term (I’ll run scenarios: 6 mo vs 12 mo, 500M vs 1B commit).
- Book 30 minutes Wed/Thu to review the Dedicated scenarios + procurement flow.

I attached the pricing preview PDF with sample math and a short worked example for 300M and 1B token buckets. Happy to run your exact token mix if you send a brief monthly split matrix (tokens by customer region + expected cache hit).

Proposed times: Wed 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 09:00–10:00 PT — which works for you?

Thanks —
